title: The Bad Breed’s breakup escalates
summary: Axl and Ian Rotten turn their former partnership into an increasingly violent rivalry. Personal stakes and changing stipulations push the feud toward one of ECW’s most notorious matches.

chapters.title: Axl wins the hair match
chapters.result: Axl defeats Ian in the hair-versus-hair match.
chapters.context: The rivalry moves beyond the team breakup into public humiliation.

chapters.title: The Taipei Death match
chapters.result: Axl defeats Ian in the Taipei Death match.
chapters.context: The glass-covered-fists stipulation becomes the feud’s most infamous escalation.
